availability.note: MY27 J8 SHS-P Summit (AWD) is the only SHS variant on the configurator, 'From $59,990*' with per-state drive-away prices; CarExpert pricing news agrees on one SHS grade. Petrol Track/Ridge are not PHEV and out of this family

listPrice.note: Jaecoo configurator variant data-price 59990.00, with separate per-state drive-away prices above it (VIC $64,581.50, NSW $64,456.60, NT $61,990.20, WA $66,220.20; 'Driveaway price includes all on-road costs (delivery fee, CTP, stamp duty, and registration)'), so $59,990 is the list price, not drive-away. 'Before on-road costs' in words: CarExpert pricing news and review; CarsGuide 2027 price page MSRP $59,990. App Vic drive-away for 59,990 = $63,389.58, $1,192 below Jaecoo's VIC figure (dealer delivery). Unlike the J7 (national DAP = MSRP + $2,000), no campaign DAP applies to the J8; only a $1,000 gift card to 30/11/2026

batteryKwh.note: Jaecoo UK '34.46 kWh traction battery' (same 1.5T 3DHT AWD pack, NCM); AU spec sheet '34'. Gross/usable not stated anywhere found; treated as usable, as on omoda-9-shs (34.46)

rangeKm.note: Jaecoo UK 8 SHS Luxury 7-seat AWD, 20in 245/50 R20 as AU: 83 miles WLTP = 133.6 km. AU spec sheet 169 km is NEDC (ADR 81/02) and higher than WLTP: rejected per direction test. CarExpert observed 124 km

consumptionKwhPer100km.note: batteryKwh / rangeKm x 100 = 34.46/134 = 25.7; AU 193 Wh/km is the NEDC ADR label (not used)

fuelConsumptionL100km.note: CarExpert review real-world hybrid mode with battery depleted: 6.6 L/100km over 100 km (closer to 10 in stop-start city). Corroborated by Auto Express 43.5 mpg (6.5 L/100km) in hybrid mode. Jaecoo UK quotes an unlabelled 50.5 mpg (5.6) beside 47 g/km; not used as it is not labelled charge-sustaining and would put the 2,275 kg J8 below same-powertrain omoda-9-shs (7.0) and chery-tiggo-9-phev-ultimate (6.3)

combinedRangeKm.note: 134 WLTP + 70 L tank (AU spec sheet) / 6.6 x 100 = 1194.6, rounded 1195

isFuelEfficientForLct.note: AU spec sheet Fuel Consumption - Combined (NEDC, ADR 81/02) 1.2 L/100km <= 3.5

isGreenForVicDuty.note: SRO green passenger car: combined tailpipe CO2 <= 120 g/km; AU spec sheet CO2 combined 28 g/km

bootLitresSeatsUp.note: All three rows up. Carwow UK spec 'Boot (seats up) 110 - 200 L', Auto Express '110 litres' in 7-seat mode. AU spec sheet and CarExpert give only 200 L 'measured up to roof'; 110 is taken as the to-the-cover figure (carwow pairs 448/738 L the same way for third row folded), method not stated by either UK source. Held 200 was the to-roof figure. Seven-seat convention: seats-up = all rows up (byd-sealion-8, kia-sorento-phev)

bootLitresSeatsDown.note: Second and third rows folded '2,021 litres' (Auto Express; carwow max 2,021). UK sells only the SHS, so battery fitted. Method unstated, likely to the roof; no to-the-belt-line figure published. Kept to-roof as jaecoo-j7-shs did today for its folded figure

towKg.note: AU spec sheet 'Maximum Towing Mass - Braked Trailer 1,600' (unbraked 750)

warrantyYears.note: 8 years/unlimited km from first registration; conditional on servicing per manufacturer guidelines (not dealer-only); no shorter private-use fallback (8 yr/150,000 km only for taxi/rideshare/rental). HV battery 8 yr/unlimited km separately

insuranceAnnual.note: kept: matches chery-tiggo-9-phev-ultimate (same 34.5 kWh 3DHT powertrain, seven seats, same $59,990) at 1950; between byd-sealion-8-dynamic-fwd ($56,990, 1850) and dynamic-awd ($63,990, 2000)

depreciationCurve.note: Omoda/Jaecoo brand convention (jaecoo-j7-shs refreshed today, omoda-9-shs, chery-tiggo-9-phev): young brand with unproven resale above $50,000, rolling gift-card/finance campaigns, J7 MY27 drive-away cuts of $3,000-4,000 within ~15 months

lowConfidence: jaecoo-j8-shs-summit.bootLitresSeatsUp: 110 L from UK carwow/Auto Express with method unstated, inferred as to-the-cover against the AU 200 L to-roof figure
jaecoo-j8-shs-summit.bootLitresSeatsDown: 2,021 L method unstated, likely to the roof; no to-cover folded figure published
jaecoo-j8-shs-summit.fuelConsumptionL100km: real-world review figure (CarExpert 6.6, Auto Express 6.5), no labelled charge-sustaining figure; Jaecoo UK's unlabelled 50.5 mpg would give 5.6
jaecoo-j8-shs-summit.combinedRangeKm: built on the review fuel figure
jaecoo-j8-shs-summit.batteryKwh: 34.46 nominal, gross vs usable never stated; consumption derived from it
